biotools.summary: AutoPipe is a platform that uses AI to generate, execute, and share reproducible, containerized bioinformatics pipelines from natural-language prompts. It enables users to visualize and manage complex analysis workflows designed for life science research.
biotools.name: AutoPipe: AI-powered Bioinformatics Pipeline Generator and Execution Platform
